features:
Key Features:

Crafted from USDA-certified organic whole grains—wheat, oats, and rice—ensuring non-GMO ingredients and sustainable farming.

Offers 16–17 grams of whole grain per cup and about 3–4 grams of dietary fiber, helping meet daily fiber goals. 

Lightly sweetened with cane sugar and cinnamon (Cinnamon Crunch) or graham-style sweet bits (Graham Crunch), with about 11 grams of sugar per serving. 

Free from artificial flavors, preservatives, and synthetic pesticides. 

Benefits:

Organic & Minimal Ingredients: Made with wholesome, recognizable ingredients and no unnecessary additives.

Whole Grain & Fiber-Packed: Supports digestive health and satiety thanks to its fiber and whole grain content.

Crowd-Pleasing Crunch: Enjoyable crisp texture that works well with milk or as a dry snack.

Family-Friendly Flavor: Cinnamon sugar or graham-sweet taste offers mild sweetness loved by both kids and adults.
ingredients: Yellow Corn Grits*, Whole Grain Wheat*, Cane Sugar*, Whole Grain Oats*, Rice*, Sunflower Oil*, Honey*, Sea Salt, Molasses*, Invert Cane Syrup*, Soy Lecithin*, Natural Flavor*. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. *Organic
